authority: Dormant local adapters, fixtures, tests and documentation only.

producer_findings.finding: The cluster has source identity, source tier, source URLs and exact publication time, but the cached display card drops source tier, exact publication time and source-to-URL evidence structure.
producer_findings.consequence: A later adapter cannot prove why a single-source story qualified or provide an exact freshness and provenance receipt.
producer_findings.required_repair: Carry a bounded source_evidence snapshot and matched Brain context through the qualified pool before display projection. Do not reconstruct it from timeAgo or presentation copy.

producer_findings.finding: verifyClaim returns evidence, but decision-watch destructures only verdict and the alert row retains no verification evidence snapshot or exact effect on the live call.
producer_findings.consequence: The legacy briefing can announce that an assumption moved without carrying the evidence receipt or a decision-specific explanation of what changes.
producer_findings.required_repair: Persist or transactionally bind a bounded verification evidence snapshot and a decision_effect before an alert may become prepared intelligence.

invariants: Corroborated news preserves distinct source receipts and exact publication time.
A reputable single-source item preserves the tier that earned admission.
Missing or stale news evidence holds rather than backfilling a live card.
A decision return is open, linked to a real decision and claim, and carries an evidence snapshot.
A decision return states the effect on the live call rather than offering a generic re-run prompt.
Both producers compose through the same prepared object and exact read/audio blocks.
